blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines — Alas Pilipinas’ Bernadeth Pons and Sisi Rondina debuted in the Asian Games 2026 with a 21-6, 21-6 rout of Bangladesh’s Most. Sabina Khatun and Mst. Lucky Khatun on Sunday at Hekinan Ryokuchi Beach Court. Pons and Rondina proved too much for the Bangladesh pair, winning in just less than 30 minutes. The Alas pair moved a game away from sweeping Pool E and advancing to the round of 16.
